items.q: And Martha Raye was popular at the time. And I was doing all the currently popular tunes.

ctx.x: Hutton led an all female orchestra.

Yeah. And so Gladys said, if you ever come to New York look me up. So that sort of put the idea in my head that I might have a chance, you know, to really do something. And I suppose by that time I was sounding a little bit like Ella, maybe Billie in doing things like that. I was certainly doing their songs. And Martha Raye was popular at the time.
